actual_viewing.inspection: All nine sheets actually viewed at original resolution; pasted native160 cells without resizing. Wider option strengthens crossing mesh under both priors; still soft/uneven far below ISO100. Main sky/building/foliage/fence remain close to parent; leaves painterly. GT recovers chiefly one direction, firstinactive unchanged. Worst amplified tail retains detached stripe island in exact blank support. Mismatch failure falsefields removed by guard. Strongest bright-sign fields retain unresolved color/clipping changes; not scored against independent exposure.

scope: Published PNGs byte-identical to audited/viewed boards. Every cell native160x160 without resizing; per-panel RGB/ROI/WB/matrix/exposure or prior native cell copy. Exact procedural GT and ideal-flat GT are labeled; real ISO100/AHD/JPEG are not exact GT. Outcome-selected active/inactive/tail/strongest-field views disclosed. Added floor affects correction only; per-context effective variance archived.
